title: The honey-coloured library
alt: A circular brass lamp hangs over a long reading table inside a honey-colored stone chapel library.
description: A detailed interior combines vaulted stone architecture, a curved mezzanine and warm reading light.
prompt: A richly detailed cinematic interior of a library inside a converted old honey-coloured stone chapel. Tall arched windows, timber bookshelves and a central long reading table create a coherent perspective. One large suspended circular brass lamp hangs from visible ceiling cables directly over the table, while a continuous curved mezzanine with a safe railing runs along the walls. Warm late-afternoon light, fine stone and paper texture, no people or readable writing.
